newsitem.title: CHILE: France protests over illegal Chile fishing boat.
newsitem.headline: France protests over illegal Chile fishing boat.

text.p: France has protested over a Chilean trawler which it said was fishing illegally in waters off remote French-owned islands in the southern Indian Ocean, a Chilean official said on Monday.

The boat Puerto Ballena, owned by the company Pesca Chile, was said to be operating last week in the exclusive economic zone surrounding the tiny Crozet archipelego which lies between Madagascar and Antarctica.

"If it is true, the Chilean government will look to apply the strictest sanctions possible as our attitude has always been to fulfil our international obligations," Deputy Fishing Minister Juan Manuel Cruz said of the complaint he received from the French embassy in Santiago.
He said the government was investigating the French complaint to decide what sanctions to apply.
